info.title: OpenStock API
info.description: API provided by Checkmate to partners to provide access to merchant codes and shopper purchase history. All endpoints are POST with batched request/response shapes. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Ask partner representative for the API key.

items.description: Matched merchants for this query. Always contains at least one entry. Misses return a single entry with `id: null`; name queries with `limit > 1` may return multiple entries.

id.description: Checkmate merchant ID, or null when not found

name.description: Merchant display name, or null when no match

unit.description: Unit for all shipping time values in this object

q1.description: First quartile (25th percentile) days to deliver, or null when unknown

q3.description: Third quartile (75th percentile) days to deliver, or null when unknown

EstimatedShipping.description: Estimated shipping time statistics, or null when unknown

queries.description: Batch of search queries (1–50). Each query returns a result with an `items` array. Name queries with `limit > 1` may yield multiple items. Misses return an `items` array with a single entry where `id` is null.

query_id.description: Caller-supplied opaque identifier correlated back in results

type.description: "name" triggers fuzzy search; "domain" is an exact-match lookup

value.description: Search term: merchant name fragment or bare domain

region.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region filter (name queries only)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return for this query (name queries only, domain queries always return at most one result). Defaults to 5.

items.description: Ranked list of offer codes (minted / static / codeless / partnership / public). Empty array on miss.

code.description: Promo code string, or null for codeless offers

probability.description: Estimated probability (0–1) that the code will work at checkout

single_use.description: True when the code expires after one redemption

value_type.description: How the discount value is expressed

value_amount.description: Numeric discount amount; semantics depend on value_type (e.g. 10 = 10% or $10)

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, present when value_type is "fixed"

conditions.description: Machine-readable condition tags (e.g. minimum_subtotal, product_restricted, applies_on_subscription)

redirect_url.description: Checkmate affiliate-attributed deep-link; null when unavailable

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the code expires, or null when it does not expire

last_success.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent successful checkout with this code, or null when never observed

description.description: Human-readable description of the offer or null

apply_count.description: Number of times this code has been applied at checkout, or null when not tracked (e.g. campaign/minted codes)

success_count.description: Number of times this code applied successfully (yielded a saving), or null when not tracked (e.g. campaign/minted codes)

query_id.description: Caller-supplied opaque identifier correlated back in results

merchant_id.description: Checkmate merchant ID obtained from the search endpoint

idempotency_key.description: Deduplication key for this query. We suggest using `sha256(user_email + date)` or similar.

items.description: Flat list of merchant interactions for this shopper. Empty array when the shopper is unknown.

query_id.description: Caller-supplied opaque identifier correlated back in results

email_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the lowercase-trimmed email address; never send the raw email

get.description: Returns the current health status of the Openstock API.

post.description: Search for merchants by name (fuzzy) or domain (exact match). Up to 20 queries per request. Each query carries its own `query_id` that is echoed back so callers can correlate responses. Each result contains an `items` array with matched merchants. Name queries return up to `limit` items per result (default 5, max 20). Misses return a single item with `id: null` — there are no 404s.

200.description: Per-query results. Each result has an `items` array. A name query with limit > 1 may produce multiple items. Misses have id: null.

400.description: Invalid request body or query cap exceeded (max 50 queries)

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limits are determined on a per partner basis.

post.description: Retrieve ranked offer codes for a set of merchants. Up to 20 queries per request. Each result contains an `items` array of codes; misses return an empty `items` array. Add an `idempotency_key` to deduplicate requests; we suggest using `sha256(user_email + date)` or similar.

200.description: Per-query results. Each result has an `items` array of codes. Misses return an empty `items` array.

400.description: Invalid request body, missing idempotency_key, or query cap exceeded (max 20)

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limits are determined on a per partner basis.

post.description: Look up purchase history for one or more shoppers identified by SHA-256 hash of their normalised (lowercase-trimmed) email address. Never send raw email addresses. Up to 20 queries per request. Each result contains a flat `items` array of merchant interactions; unknown shoppers return an empty `items` array — there are no 404s.

200.description: Per-query shopper history. Each result has a flat `items` array of merchant interactions. Unknown shoppers return an empty array.

400.description: Invalid request body, malformed email_sha256, or query cap exceeded (max 20)

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limits are determined on a per partner basis.
